title: DeepSeek Introduces Vision
summary: DeepSeek, a leading AI company known for their open-source language models, has introduced Vision capabilities to their platform, enabling multimodal AI interactions that can process and understand images alongside text.
problem_solved: Expands DeepSeek's capabilities beyond text-only AI to include visual understanding, allowing users to upload and analyze images within conversations.
why_valuable: Provides an open-source alternative to proprietary multimodal AI systems like GPT-4V, making vision capabilities more accessible to developers and researchers.
